entities.name: Yemima Avidar-Tchernovitz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yemima Avidar-Tchernovitz was an Israeli author whose works became classics of modern Hebrew children's literature. Born in Vilna, Lithuania, in 1909, she arrived in Palestine in 1921, at the age of 12.
